decisions.reason: As a low-cost accessory tightly linked to the trailer core business, it remains worth keeping on offer because the downside of continuation is small.
This box trailer line sits squarely in the firm's main competencies and customer base, so a medium German trailer maker would usually continue it unless results had turned clearly weak.

The low-bed series is close to the firm's established product logic and still offers strategic option value, though its broader model range makes pruning somewhat more conceivable than for accessories.
As a complementary cover range that supports trailer sales and likely requires limited additional commitment, it is sensible to keep the option open.
